# NeonX Studio

NeonX Studio is an independent creative studio at the intersection of games and artificial intelligence. It explores original interactive experiences, authored worlds, systemic storytelling, and bounded AI systems. The studio slogan is "Shape the Future of AI and Games."

- Home: https://neonx.top/
- About: https://neonx.top/about.html
- Projects: https://neonx.top/projects.html
- Light: https://neonx.top/light.html
- Journal: https://neonx.top/journal.html
- Contact: https://neonx.top/contact.html
- Public email: neon_x_studio@163.com
- GitHub organization: https://github.com/NeonX-Studio

## Public project

- **Light** is an AI-native systemic narrative RPG prototype set in Light City, a three-layer underground civilization built after a surface catastrophe.
- The project uses a bounded AI reasoning layer for context-aware dialogue, tasks, and event proposals while gameplay rules, permissions, world state, and persistence remain authoritative.
- Publicly stated technology direction: Unreal Engine 5.8.3 and C++.
- The Light source repository, production assets, internal data, prompts, and development tools remain private.

## Editorial boundaries

The site publishes confirmed studio positioning and public project direction. It does not claim a founding date, location, team size, clients, awards, social accounts, or project promises without confirmation.
